messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI broke on routing-editor roundtrip tests after we swapped YAML serializer. failing test: test_editor_roundtrip_comments.
sam: Steps to repro?
maya: repo infra/routing, branch config-editor/roundtrip-fix. run `pytest tests/integration/test_roundtrip.py::test_editor_roundtrip_comments`. infra-ci-bot has logs.
infra-ci-bot: build: https://ci.redwood.example/1854123456/build/107 — failed on `test_editor_roundtrip_comments` (exit 1).
lee: quick scan: we replaced ruamel with pyyaml.safe_dump to reduce deps; pyyaml drops comments & anchors. two options: bring ruamel back for editor save, or stash raw text in metadata so we can rehydrate on reopen.
alex: UX caveat: keeping raw text means editor preview/lint need canonical AST. if we render raw for preview, linting might miss schema errors.
zara: hybrid idea: preserve comments for editor save roundtrip only (ruamel), but keep backend canonicalization using pyyaml so validators operate on normalized YAML. annotate schema for comment-sensitive fields like `config` so linter knows to require preservation.
sam: agree. add a lint rule to detect saves that would drop user comments that look like human annotations (e.g., lines starting with `# NOTE` or `# owner:`). that would have prevented a support ticket this week.
maya: failing example in test:
```
# per-tenant override
routes:
  - id: banner
    match:
      header: x-tenant
    config: |
      weight: 1
```
after save/reopen comments gone.
lee: minimal quickfix: switch back to `ruamel.yaml.round_trip_dump` only inside EditorSaveService, fall back to pyyaml.safe_dump for any backend persist/canonical dumps. I'll draft a PR.
alex: add a golden-file test for editor saves: CI should fail on textual diffs for editor save roundtrip (explicit invariant), but not for backend-normalized outputs. makes the intent explicit.
zara: schema tweak idea: add `x-preserve-comments: true` on fields where comments are semantically important. our linting pipeline can consult that. also add `__raw_head_comments` metadata as fallback if ruamel is delayed.
sam: writing tests: small unit and integration. sample unit: `test_editor_save_preserves_comments` writes YAML with a leading comment and asserts saved output contains it. for integration, roundtrip the entire sample file and diff. mark flakiness on mac runners.
maya: file a docs ticket so support knows why editor save diffs vs backend dumps happen. include the golden-file behavior in docs.
infra-ci-bot: label added: requires-linux
lee: if ruamel import is contentious, implement best-effort re-injection: on save, detect comment blocks attached to top-level nodes and stash into `{metadata: {__raw_comments: ...}}`, on open re-inject before rendering in editor. fragile but buy us time.
alex: also update console docs and the editor UI tooltip: "Editor preserves user comments where possible; backend stores canonical form for linting and deployments."
zara: I'll update lint rules + schema, add test coverage for `x-preserve-comments`.
sam: PR plan: tests + schema + EditorSaveService change (ruamel guarded) + CI label. pinging @lee for the WIP PR.
lee: opening WIP: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/999 (WIP). tagging @sam @zara @maya for review.
maya: thanks. once CI passes add golden-file artifacts to `tests/goldens/editor_saves/`.
alex: one more: add an automerge block until golden diffs pass to avoid accidental roll forward.
sam: noted. will add `requires-manual-merge` if golden diffs need human review. :thumbsup:
zara: great teamwork, landing sequence should be: schema + linter -> tests -> editor save implementation -> docs update.
maya: sounds good, I'll follow up in the PR comments.
lee: thanks all :rocket:
